images.alt: A quiet provincial street of low concrete houses under flat overcast daylight.
Seen from behind, a woman works at a monitor at a cluttered home desk beside a jalousie window in early-morning light.
A close view of a well-used notebook with handwritten notes softened out of focus, a pen lying on the page and a hand resting at its edge.
A desk corner and shelf of well-thumbed notebooks and spiral-bound manuals with torn paper page tabs, shot at an angle in window light.
A woman at a corner desk reviews a spreadsheet on a second monitor, a headset resting beside her laptop.
A blank notebook and pen beside a closed laptop on a wooden desk in morning light.
A person in a headset speaks mid-sentence at a plain desk, a closed notebook and a mug beside a switched-off laptop.
A person sits upright at a desk in front of a plain wall during a video call on a laptop, an open notebook beside them.
A man reads a well-used printed manual at a desk, seen from the side with his head down, an overcast window behind him.
A person in a co-working space reads a document on a tablet at a shared table.
A young man sets up a second-hand monitor and tests a headset in a small bedroom office with jalousie windows.
